summary: This lecture explores modern security architectures, contrasting perimeter-based access control with Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA). It delves into ZTA principles like least privilege and micro-segmentation, supported by technologies such as blockchains and smart contracts. The discussion also covers behavioral analytics, privacy preservation techniques, advanced access control models like RBAC, and the critical aspects of security failure modes and the evolution of mobile OS security.
title: Zero Trust Architecture, Security Principles, and Failure Modes
